closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin C, protein, and brings a clean fruit identity, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein quality, and low starch. It is good for immune support, practical meals, and low-calorie volume because vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
